title: The Map Marked with the Kind Route
youtube_title: The Map Marked with the Kind Route | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing who helped, and helping back, keeps a home kind.
summary: At a bedroom with the hall light still on, Golda notices that Grandma Nia has already taken care of a map marked with the route that had more benches. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Golda does one useful thing Grandma Nia did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
